original_hypothesis: The truncated-grid defect is not a one-off in RV-377-045: it is systemic in this programme, because every frontier grid in the lane was chosen for legibility (H up to 128, or up to 1024) rather than computed from the price vectors the receipt itself reports. Rows whose serving price is low but whose development or update price is high are pushed out of every grid cell by their intercept, and the grid then reads as 'this row occupies no cell' when the truthful statement is 'this row occupies no cell below H'. minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED module gmi_microscope/grid_audit.py. For every committed receipt in microscopes/results/ that reports a frontier grid: (i) reconstruct each row's cost line from the RECEIPT'S OWN description and per-query coordinates -- for the STAGE_DE_* family from R_by_cell through smooth.per_event and smooth.cost, C = desc + H*exec_q + r*upd_e + r*ver_e + (r/4)*rev_e; for the STAGE_DC_*/STAGE_DN_* family from cells[...]['desc_bits'] and cells[...]['exec_per_query'] (reduced price) or cells[...]['native_ops']/n_queries (native price), C = desc_bits + H*per_query; (ii) SOUNDNESS GATE: recompute the receipt's own reported frontier on its own grid and require it to agree cell for cell -- a receipt whose frontier cannot be reproduced from its own contents is reported UNAUDITABLE with the reason and is never reported SAFE; (iii) for every context (column, price, precision, revision rate) and every ordered pair of admissible rows compute the analytic crossover H* = (A_i(r) - A_j(r))/(E_j - E_i) exactly in rationals, and compare it with the grid maximum H_max; (iv) verdict SAFE if the frontier occupant set is constant for every H > H_max in every context, TRUNCATED otherwise, graded MAJOR when a row that occupies ZERO cells of the reported grid occupies at least one cell beyond H_max (this is exactly a 'no cell exists' clause checked on a truncated grid) and MINOR when the occupant changes only among rows that already occupy cells; (v) for every TRUNCATED receipt, RE-RUN the frontier on an extended grid reaching past the largest crossover found and record which cells and which occupancy statements change. Clause units: RECEIPTS (SAFE / TRUNCATED / UNAUDITABLE), CELLS of a frontier grid, reuse horizon H in queries per lifecycle, and crossovers H* in the same unit. Frontier rule: each receipt is audited under its OWN declared frontier rule and its own admissible set, read from the receipt; for the STAGE_DE_* family that is R-top (protocol rule 17), for the others the receipt's own admissible flag.
